title: Scalar naturality of the ordinary normalized refinement word
statement: Fix the finite-field and relative separated finite-type scheme data and coefficient stages of [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data, def-sf-constructible-exceptional-assembly-data], with compactifications c,d and a proper refinement r [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Suppose normalized natural open-unit comparisons epsilon_s:I_X,s j_d,! isomorphic to I_X,s j_c,! Rr_* and coefficient pullback composition equalities are supplied. Form beta_s by the inverse proper compositor followed by proper pushforward of epsilon_s inverse [lem-sf-ring-open-refinement]. For an extension i:E to L of coefficient fields, a finite-Tor input K over E, another finite-Tor input Kprime over L, and an ambient isomorphism e:I_X,L Kprime isomorphic to T_X(I_X,E K), the ordinary completed scalar maps satisfy T_Y(beta_E(K)) q_d(K) = q_c(K) H_c(e inverse) beta_L(Kprime) H_d(e). Here H_c,H_d are the ordinary completed proper/open images, q_c,q_d are their specified scalar comparisons, and composition is written left to right. This is a scalar square of ordinary derived maps; it makes no choice of exceptional operations or adjunction refinements.

source.place: Section 5, Lemma 5.13 and Constructions 5.14--5.15; proper/open scalar square and its normalized integral realization, refinement construction step 6.

proof.text: Postcomposition with the invertible refinementRestriction and the open Hom adjunction show that each supplied epsilon component is the canonical refinementOpenMap. Use the ordinary inner scalar refinement square, invert the supplied epsilon components, and use naturality to replace the scalar input by Kprime along e.

Factor the compact-support scalar comparison into the proper scalar comparison followed by the proper image of the open scalar comparison. Naturality moves the proper scalar comparison across epsilon inverse. Whisker the inner scalar equation by the outer proper image, apply the inverse proper scalar-composition identity, and use naturality of the inverse proper compositor. The remaining maps are precisely the explicit ringRefinementWord and the H_c(e inverse), H_d(e) endpoint maps.

proof_origin.note: Direct ordinary coefficient-mate calculation. The system scalar square and normalized compactification realization are not needed for this word identity. The unit route and every existing statement remain unchanged.

theorem ring_refinement_scalar_word
  (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
  {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
  [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
  [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    {c d : Compactification f} (r : c.Refinement d)
    (hi : ∀ s : RingStage.{max u v} l, (s.coefficients l).pull (c.i ≫ r.hom) =
        proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i r.hom
          ((s.coefficients l).ring d.Z) ((s.coefficients l).ring c.Z)
          ((s.coefficients l).ring X)
          ((s.coefficients l).pull r.hom) ((s.coefficients l).pull c.i))
    (hg : ∀ s : RingStage.{max u v} l, (s.coefficients l).pull (r.hom ≫ d.g) =
        proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients r.hom d.g
          ((s.coefficients l).ring Y) ((s.coefficients l).ring d.Z)
          ((s.coefficients l).ring c.Z)
          ((s.coefficients l).pull d.g) ((s.coefficients l).pull r.hom))
    (ε : ∀ s : RingStage.{max u v} l, RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s ⋙
          (PurCompactSupport.openExtension (s.coefficients l) d.i).mapDerivedCategory ≅
        RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s ⋙
          ((PurCompactSupport.openExtension (s.coefficients l) c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
            PurCompactSupport.push (s.coefficients l) r.hom))
    (hε : ∀ (s : RingStage.{max u v} l) (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (s.stage l)),
        (PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction (s.coefficients l) d.i).homEquiv _ _
            ((ε s).hom.app K) ≫
            PurCompactSupport.refinementRestriction (s.coefficients l) r (hi s)
              ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K) =
          (PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction (s.coefficients l) c.i).unit.app
            ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K))
    (E L : FieldStage.{max u v} l) (i : E.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] L.carrier)
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.integral E)) (K' : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.integral L))
    (e : (RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X (.integral L)).obj K' ≅
      (pbcDerivedExtend ((PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier L.carrier i).map X)).obj
        ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X (.integral E)).obj K)) :
    let a := PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier L.carrier i
    let Hc := PurCompactSupport.image ((RingStage.integral L).coefficients l) c
    let Hd := PurCompactSupport.image ((RingStage.integral L).coefficients l) d
    (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map Y)).map
        ((ringRefinementWord.{u, v} l Ω r (.integral E) (hg _) (ε _)).hom.app K) ≫
        (PurCompactSupport.comparison a d).app K.obj =
      (PurCompactSupport.comparison a c).app K.obj ≫ Hc.map e.inv ≫
        (ringRefinementWord.{u, v} l Ω r (.integral L) (hg _) (ε _)).hom.app K' ≫
        Hd.map e.hom
